mentions.name: Tritium
mentions.description: A web-embeddable legal IDE for transactional AI-native law firms. It handles Docx, PDF and Markdown documents in the browser with features like redlining and go-to definition, and is written in Rust.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Tritium, the legal IDE: https://tritium.legal/preview

Building the web-embeddable legal IDE for transactional AI-native law firms. Docx, PDF and Markdown in the browser with redlining, go-to definition and more. In Rust, of course.
mentions.author: piker
